title: Give Engram doctor output its own explicit byte bound and diagnostics
outcome: Combined MAIN Claude review session-6499: doctor now uses read_engram_cli_output, capped at ENGRAM_CONTROL_MAX_FRAME_BYTES (256 KiB) for each stream, replacing unbounded wait_with_output. Above-bound reports fail with an unrelated maximum control frame message. Define a deliberate doctor-specific report/output bound and diagnostic; add above-bound coverage and retain resource protection. Do not infer report size from audit duration: existing tracked measurements are about 4.6 KB stdout, not evidence of a current oversized real report. Related concurrent-drain fix tm-s2ce and deadline cleanup tm-ng02 remain separate. Source-confirmed behavior, no executed oversized-doctor reproduction in parent review.
